narr: Thunderstorms training over northern Menominee County caused flash flooding from Cunard to Hermansville on the afternoon of the 14th. Portions of the Hermanville Golf Course were under water from the storms.
ev: Social media posts and dual-pol radar estimated four to eight inches of rain on the afternoon of the 14th from Cunard to Hermansville. There were pictures posted of roads flooded near Cunard and the golf course flooded in Hermansville.
